title: Meeting Count Basie in Okmulgee with Gonzell White's show
summary: He recalls first meeting Basie around 1925-26 with Gonzell White's road show, seeing his first hundred dollar bill.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Oh. I didn't tell you that when I was in Okmulgee, you know who I met? Count Basie, guy named Zeddie played trumpet, and one other , Kelly somebody. Somebody named Kelly. Two trumpet players.
No, no, George played the tenor saxophone.
Guy Kelly. And they were with a show named Gonzell White. This was the first time that I ever saw a hundred dollar bill. Gonzell White had it. That was Basie's
Basie was traveling with that show?
Gonzell White. Now those two names may not be the other two musicians that were with him, but there were two trumpet players and Basie. That was when I first met Basie. That was back in 1925 or 1926.
Before he even came to Kansas City.
